> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/functional-completeness.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **140** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5495331fccb4dc1ff884c485ea66e682eae61402` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `9ae75989da7b0f8c8ad4b6d5ceeb7f483a4f4748` — the merge of head `0b3e83ce57bfe9617addf02930965fbf86d14997` into base `5495331fccb4dc1ff884c485ea66e682eae61402`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 9ae75989da7b0f8c8ad4b6d5ceeb7f483a4f4748 && git checkout 9ae75989da7b0f8c8ad4b6d5ceeb7f483a4f4748
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5495331fccb4dc1ff884c485ea66e682eae61402 0b3e83ce57bfe9617addf02930965fbf86d14997 && git checkout -B drift-repro 5495331fccb4dc1ff884c485ea66e682eae61402 && git merge --no-ff 0b3e83ce57bfe9617addf02930965fbf86d14997

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5495331fccb4dc1ff884c485ea66e682eae61402
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 5495331fccb4dc1ff884c485ea66e682eae61402` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0b3e83ce57bfe9617addf02930965fbf86d14997`
Local-runs: none

PR #22592 for card #22476, judged on the head's net diff against its merge base with `main` (`96e4be482`): 21 files, +476/−111. Inputs: the card body and its eleven comments (the triage grade `6080566395`, the claims `6084200234` / `6091513811`, both releases, the unblock `6091587399`, the os-dev report `6092996725`, the seat's ACCEPT `6093019515`), the PR body and file list, the diff, and the check-runs on the head. Readings taken in this act, each a read and none a build, test or gate run: the diff over `packages/spec/src/**` non-test files was stripped mechanically of comment lines and string-fragment lines; the objectui files the records cite were read at `20c6d351ad74` through REST; the objectui tree at that commit was fetched as a tarball and the six migration entries' corpus tokens re-counted over it; the three objectui compares were re-read.

### ① Derived judgments

Every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each judged:

1. **`.objectui-sha` `47b1f0bb7174` → `20c6d351ad74d2b14a93becdc134d51b91b2d2e6` — the bundled console (`@objectstack/console` dist) moves by 24 objectui commits.** Right. Forward only: the compares re-read in this act are `47b1f0bb7174...20c6d351ad74` ahead 24 / behind 0, `2a48bd408dab...20c6d351ad74` ahead 7 / behind 0 (the card's acceptance: objectui#12056's fix is inside the pin), `8a55f0ccda...20c6d351ad74` ahead 5 / behind 0 (the #22487 edge, cleared in `6086630440` before this bump was cut). `Console Pin Gate` on this head reads `success`, so the pin builds against this tree. The spec write door already refuses every list-view key the two breaking `plugin-list` commits (`3fd862510`, `025341692`) stop reading, and `3c3115e38` follows the spec's declared `editInline` default — the console catches up to accept-set decisions the spec published earlier; this diff publishes no new narrowing.
2. **`ui/view.zod.ts` `FormField.span` `.describe(...)` — the one non-comment, non-string-fragment token change in any `packages/spec/src/**` non-test file (the mechanical strip leaves exactly this line).** Right. Only the pin sha inside the text moves (`47b1f0bb7174` → `20c6d351ad74`); the claim it makes (which widget types resolve to the full column count, one clamped col-span class per tier) is unchanged, and the docblock above it records the three objectui files it rests on as byte-identical across the hop. It reaches the published JSON-schema `description` and the generated `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`, which the diff regenerates in step. The enum, its default and the key are untouched: no accept-set change.
3. **Six `migrations/entries/semantic/18.*-unit-in-key.ts` `reason` strings, mirrored by the generated `migrations/registry.ts` — exported values that ship in `@objectstack/spec`.** Right, meaning unchanged: each entry still asserts the same thing (the pinned objectui checkout spells the retired key or def zero times) at the new pin, with the prior pin's reading appended to its chain, as every earlier bump did. The two entries that gain a `+` (metrics, tracing) gain a string fragment and nothing else. Re-counted in this act over the tree at `20c6d351ad74`: 8351 files; `resourceLimits` 2, both prose in `packages/app-shell` (`runtime-config.ts:272`, `__tests__/spec-symbol-parity.test.ts:188`) as the runtime-config entry says; `RuntimeConfig` 337, `Span` 517, `SpanSchema` 57, `tenant` 1340, `period` 249, `interval` 213, `metrics` 456, `window` 4470, `useState` 2630, `timeout` 1694, `objectstack` 18047, `@objectstack/spec` 7545; the zero tokens sampled (`debounceDelay`, `flushInterval`, `initialDelay`, `HttpDestinationConfig`, `LoggingConfig`, `schemaCacheTtl`) read 0; `TTL` reads 170 text matches plus the 14 binary-file lines `git grep` prints to stdout, which is the entries' 184 — the entries' own method reproduces every reading.
4. **`kernel/functional-completeness.ts` — docblock only (+41/−4).** Right. The calendar, gantt, timeline and map rows' asserting citations are re-pointed with hop sentences; `VIEW_BINDING_BLOCKS`, `VIEW_BINDING_FIX`, `VIEW_BINDING_MESSAGE` and `unboundBlockMessage` — the exported and runtime carriers — are untouched. The hop sentences hold against `ListView.tsx` at the pin: `case 'calendar'` at `:3665`, `case 'gantt'` at `:3804`, `case 'timeline'` at `:3747`, `case 'map'` at `:3924`, `resolveTimelineDateBinding` at `:686`; the timeline title floor `dateBinding.titleField || 'name'` (`:3797`) and the gallery floor (`:3743`) still stand. The kanban and tree rows are the first ③ item below.
5. **`ui/component.zod.ts` (+184/−42), `ui/action.zod.ts`, `ui/dataset.zod.ts` — docblocks and comments only.** Right: the strip leaves no line in them, so no schema, key, default, enum member, guidance string or export moves. The re-pointed anchors were spot-read at the pin and hold: `ListView.tsx:86` `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_SPELLING`, `:200` `resolveListMapConfig`, the tree arm `3965-3989` emitting `labelField: treeCfg.labelField || 'name'` at `:3986` with no `titleField`; `KanbanImpl.tsx:671` / `:684` `quickAdd && onQuickAdd`; `ActionRunner.ts:1498` `composeSuccessMessage`; `ObjectView.tsx:2461` `case 'map':`; `objectql.zod.ts:2523` `ObjectMapConfigSchema`, closed `.strict()` at `:2532`, `LIST_VIEW_LOCAL_OVERRIDES` at `:1506` still without `map`; `previews/block-config.ts` inspectors `311-351` (`columns` at `:335`, the repeater at `344-351` with its `object` and `limit` rows `at: 'dataSource'`); `data-objectstack/src/index.ts` `translateFilterArray` arm ending `:5059`, `serializeOrderBy` `868-894`; `ObjectTimeline.tsx:30` default 100, `:589-591` a start-date chain ending in the flat `schema.dateField` with no literal rung, `:952` the refusal arm. The three quoted `view.zod.ts` anchors (`:200`, `:2461`, `:2523`) are among them.
6. **`scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` — records re-pointed.** Right. The manifest's sha256 and component count (107) do not move; the lockstep's grammar region, codes and predicate do not move; neither file ships (`@objectstack/sdui-parser` publishes `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`). Nothing else publishes.
7. **Three test files** — comment-only re-citations; no public surface.

**`Clause-②: no` is right for this diff.** The `@objectstack/spec` accept set does not move (item 2 is the whole token-level change, and it is a description sha); the console's behaviour moves only toward decisions the spec already published (item 1). The PR body's line 2 and the spec changeset agree, and the two precedent bump PRs (#22496, #22412) carried the same line. No `(narrowing)` arm is owed.

### ② Semver level

- **`.changeset/console-20c6d351ad74.md` — `@objectstack/console` minor.** Matches what publishes: the console dist at the new pin. The digest's highest declared level is `minor` (33 of 33 changesets releasing; six carry the author's BREAKING annotation under objectui's no-`major` window policy, each marked in the list). Same shape as the two precedent console changesets with BREAKING entries on `main` (`console-f0268ad78485.md`, `console-a58626c88dc8.md`: `minor`, same marker). The ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` is right: the diff adds, removes or renames no ObjectStack-authorable key, no stored shape and no FROM → TO prescription; the comment answers each of the six annotated entries and the three `!` subjects by name. `check-adr-0087-registration` reads the BREAKING banner as the breaking signal and the marker as the disposition; the console changeset owes no `Clause-②` line of its own (the precedents carry none either, and the gate's arm reading only adds a signal on `narrowing`).
- **`.changeset/objectui-pin-citations-20c6d351ad74.md` — `@objectstack/spec` patch, `Clause-②: no`.** Matches: description text (one describe's sha, six migration readings) and comments, nothing else; same shape as `objectui-pin-citations-47b1f0bb7174.md` on `main`. Its body's claims (four changed readings named, one dead read reported and not rewritten, every zero token still zero) agree with the diff and with the readings above.
- Nothing publishes from any other package. `Check Changeset` reads `success` on the head.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report `6092996725`: `open_questions` empty; eight deviations; two out-of-scope findings (carrier: none). Each:

- **`functional-completeness.ts` kanban and tree rows (out-of-scope finding 1).** Confirmed at the pin: `ListView.tsx:3637` reads `groupByField || detectStatusField(objectDef)` (the `groupField` alias retired, `:3616`) and `:3986` reads `labelField || 'name'`. So the docblock rows (`kanban → groupByField || groupField || …`, `tree → labelField || titleField || 'name'`) and the sentence saying both "were re-read at the pin as well and still say what they say" are stale by one alias rung each. No runtime carrier is wrong: `unboundBlockMessage` (kanban and tree still infer or floor a literal) and `VIEW_BINDING_FIX` (`groupByField`; `parentField`, `labelField`) prescribe the right keys. The acceptance-note disposition is within Prime Directive #10 — no defect, contract violation or authoring trap. **Escalated to the dispatching seat, not holding this verdict:** those rows carry no asserting citation, so no later bump reds on them; a carrier is owed — the `domain:spec` lane's PR #22421 (#11509), which merges `main` after this lands and already works this surface, or a filed card.
- **`OBJECT_TREE_FLAT_CONFIG_GUIDANCE` `titleField` rationale (out-of-scope finding 2).** Confirmed dead at the pin: the tree arm emits no `titleField`, and the renderer half was already gone (objectui#8841). The diff changes neither the key set nor the prescription string; the hop sentence above the docblock names the dead read, and this record carries an asserting citation, so the next bump reds on it. The prescription authors see still names the right key (`tree.labelField`); its last clause ("only ever read as that key's last fallback") now describes a read that exists nowhere — stale rationale, not a wrong prescription. Keeping or dropping `titleField` from the flat key set is a schema decision, rightly out of a pin bump. Same follow-up carrier as the item above.
- **Deviations.** (1) The teardown-shape self-test's fixture fetch: a checkout prerequisite, not a gate change. (2) The build restart: nothing. (3) No labels written: the path and size labels are `pr-automation.yml`'s, as for #22412. (4) `origin/main` moved after the last merge — three commits now (`25be87612`, `5495331fc`, `6a06e3b00`); one of this PR's 21 files, the generated `migrations/registry.ts`, moved on `main` with #22563, in hunks disjoint from this PR's six (`main` at 5773 and 14222–14357; this PR at 15261 and below). GitHub reads the PR `mergeable`, and the queue's rebuilt generation runs `check:migration-registry`, which is where a textual merge of a generated file is judged (Multi-agent discipline §10–§11); a `git merge origin/main` before enqueue settles it in advance at no cost. (5) objectui `main` moved past the cut: the claim `6091513811` names `main` at cut time; right. (6) The console build from a scratch clone: right — no worktree registered in the sibling checkout. (7) Spec vitest ran `--project local` only: the `repo` project is CI's, under `Test Core` (reading below). (8) Model-free commit trailers: AGENTS.md's form.
- **Serial constraints.** `.objectui-sha` is written by this PR alone: PR #22496 merged first (`6091587399`), and `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path` reads `success`. The #22487 edge is cleared (`6086630440`). Not a release act: `packages/console/package.json` and `CHANGELOG.md` are untouched; the console's release input is its changeset.

**Check-runs on `0b3e83ce5`, read at 2026-10-10T03:07Z:** 38 runs — 28 `success`, 4 `skipped` (the opt-in tarball smoke and the re-run's Auto Label / PR Size), 6 `in_progress`: `Lint & Repo Gates` and `Test Core` 1/6–5/6. `success` already: `Console Pin Gate`, `Build Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate` (aggregate and all three shards), `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Type Check · workspace` / `source gates` / `consumer gates` / `debt ledger`, `Test Core (6/6)`, `Check Changeset`, `Spec property liveness`, the single-writer-path and claim guards. Landing waits for every required context green; this record does not stand in for a check.
